# Cloudflarebase

> The open-source Firebase for Cloudflare: auth, a realtime document database, and SQL tables, each running as a Cloudflare Agent with one Durable Object per project. Globally replicated by default, no egress fees, self-hosted in your own Cloudflare account.

Cloudflarebase is agent-first: every backend primitive ships as a versioned npm package you add to your own Worker with the `cloudflarebase` CLI, not a service you rent. Projects support whole-backend branching, and cloudflarebase.com runs a live demo that needs no account.

## Site

- [Home](https://cloudflarebase.com/): what it is, how it compares to Firebase and Supabase, architecture, and roadmap.
- [Pricing](https://cloudflarebase.com/pricing): the same workload priced on Cloudflare, Firebase, and Supabase, with dated sources.
- [Live demo](https://cloudflarebase.com/dashboard): an ephemeral throwaway project, no sign-up.

## Source

- [GitHub](https://github.com/cloudflarebase/cloudflarebase): the whole repository, including both agents and the CLI.
- [@cloudflarebase/auth](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cloudflarebase/auth): Better Auth in a per-project Durable Object.
- [@cloudflarebase/db](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cloudflarebase/db): documents and typed SQL tables, both with live queries.
- [@cloudflarebase/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cloudflarebase/cli): `init`, `add <agent>`, `deploy`, `schema`.
